notes:
- Speech recognition: Fun-ASR-Nano is about twice as fast – it reads in bfloat16 (half the graphics memory) and reads neighbouring speech parts in one go; in a Batch it stays loaded between videos (no 30 s load for each).
- SenseVoice: lines are whole sentences, cut at the words' own times – as natural as Fun-ASR-Nano and still the fastest.
- New speech recognition: Qwen3-ASR (Chinese + 22 dialects) – install it once with setup_qwen3asr.bat.
- Paraformer: lines are cut at the punctuation – the voice no longer starts a word or two too early or late.
- Gemini Router: a new live page – every key (and web account) around the router, a line lights up from the one that is working (translation, characters, AI check …), the videos being translated, a live feed, Parts at once and Auto fallback.
- Translate: the parts of a video are translated side by side (up to 4 keys at once); a key or model that does not answer in time hands over sooner.
- Google Translate (free) is better: names are written in Khmer and kept the same, English words left in a line are translated, your corrections are used.
- Khmer translation: 老周 → ពូចូវ, 小王 → អាវ៉ាង; prices and numbers in digits (១២.៩ យ័ន); a translation put on the wrong line is asked again.
- Voice: lines too long for their time are said shorter and said faster in one round (before: three); a stuck Edge line no longer holds the Voice for minutes.
- Batch "At once 2" works on a 4 GB graphics card with Fun-ASR-Nano + Edge: one video reads its speech while the other translates, voices and exports.
- Subtitles from the video that repeat a heard line are one line (no word voiced twice); sounds only ("嘶嘶嘶", "哈哈哈") are not dubbed.
- Glossary: a single video keeps its story's names (and shop names) in its own folder – the next episodes use the same Khmer names.
- Style › Subtitles: "⭐ Use this look for every new video". Translation tab: ▤ Simple view and 🔍 Find & Replace.
- AI check, characters and the Gemini steps have a time limit – the Dub no longer hangs when every key is used up.
